# Background Research Checklist: background research during the Define grill

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for parallel research, the git check, and the hand-off to Plan, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Parallel research

- [ ] CHK001 Is "quick look" defined well enough to judge when research must start and when it must not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "the same scope" defined well enough to judge a second start as a repeat? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the cap of 3 stated as agents running at one time, not agents per run? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the order in which queued scopes start defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the short-name rule stated so two agents can never get the same file? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it stated that the no-OK rule applies in Define only, and that a lone grill keeps the OK step? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]

## Git check

- [ ] CHK007 Is the ignore list stated as exact paths, with nothing else in `specs/` ignored? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it defined which feature folder the ignore list uses in a redo and when `state.json` names an older feature? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec say whether a hand run of `/stratum:st-research` outside Define uses the same ignore list? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Gate and hand-off to Plan

- [ ] CHK010 Is "a finding that changes the spec" defined well enough to judge which findings show before the gate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the form in which Define passes queued scopes to Plan defined, so it survives between the two phases? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the `Sources` list format in `research.md` defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Do FR-012 and FR-013 agree on which rule wins when a feature has both a `research/` folder and an old `research.md` from `st-research`? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]

## Tests

- [ ] CHK014 Is "negative control" defined as a broken copy that makes the check fail, for each new check? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the live checks (two agents at once, no wait) named as manual steps with exact actions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §Assumptions]
